root.source: The World is the root every region sits under, not a region, so the policy neither holds nor omits it

other_states.source: States outside UN membership: the UN General Assembly's non-member observer states (Holy See, State of Palestine) and states with limited recognition (Kosovo, Taiwan)

region_gaps.reason: resolvekit 0.1.12 holds 18 territories as no country, places almost no former state in a region, and places Kosovo (XKS) and the French Southern Territories (ATF) in no region
